data.name: Sailing Era Demo
data.detailed_description:
In this demo, we provide the very first chapter and 2 main characters for you to try the game.
Currently no English support, but we will update the languages soon!

Sailing Era is a Maritime Trade & Strategy Game set in the age when the ocean connected the world.
It tells the legendary story of four young captains from Portugal, Arabia, China, and Japan as they explore the world.
Sailing, trade, adventure, naval battles...
Experience the eternal charm of ancient civilizations while exploring the world of diverse cultures,
And discover the courage and determination to break free from shackles while journeying into the unknown.
Every voyage
Is a journey of "Sailing & Beyond"!
